tolerance.why: a 12-bit sliding-histogram median is within one 12-bit step

note: cv2.medianBlur accepts floats only for sizes 3 and 5, and its 8-bit route isn't precise enough: on Cady it moves one screen peak by a frequency bin (results.json, detect_screen). Here the 8-bit route differs by up to 0.0067, a 12-bit median by up to 0.00042. Note the border: scipy reflects (mode='reflect'); medianBlur replicates.
